summary: Expanded multi-host verification harness + certification for CLI-agnostic claims (Issue #269 / Epic: beta-roadmap)

entries.surface: tests/e2e/ (README + enhanced structure spec jsdoc), template_payload/tests/e2e/README.md (plate-specific harness doc)
entries.summary: Added dedicated tests/e2e/README.md documenting the verification harness purpose, how to run, what passing means for certification, and exact recipe for adapting to a new host CLI. Updated template_payload copy for downstream. Enhanced plugin-structure.spec.ts jsdoc to reference the harness. Covers ACs for docs + simulation (structure tests are host-independent cert).
entries.migration_impact: New plate adopters (or hosts) get the harness docs in their seeded tests/e2e/ or by inspecting the plate repo. Run `cd tests/e2e && npm install && npm test` to certify. Existing setups unaffected.
entries.agent_notes: When working on plugin/CLI-agnostic changes, run the e2e harness (structure tests always, host tests when binary available) and update expectations + this README + fragment. Use it to validate MCP/agent contract changes. See #269 for certification checklist.
